_readme: Pages that deliberately do NOT appear in their lane's hub. Read by scripts/lib/library-hub-registry.js, consulted by both npm run audit:library-hub-coverage and the PR gate npm run check:library-hub-coverage. Before this file existed the repo had no way to express the intent at all, so every page absent from its hub was indistinguishable from an oversight — which is why the 2026-08-26 audit could classify nothing as 'intentionally excluded' and had to report all 374 absences as defects. An entry here is a DISCUSSED DECISION between you and the user, exactly like data/translation_parity_exceptions.json and data/english_parent_exceptions.json. Never add one to make a page you want to ship pass the gate: if the gate flags a page, the default fix is to register it in the hub. Entry shape: { route, reason, decided, decidedBy } — `route` is the public path with a trailing slash (e.g. '/es/library/foo/'), `reason` says why the hub should not list it in prose a future session can evaluate, `decided` is an ISO date, `decidedBy` names the discussion. The list is empty on purpose: as of 2026-08-26 no page has an agreed exclusion, and an empty ledger is the honest state rather than a seeded one.
